title: A ticked customer with no channel blocks the button
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Sign in as an Admin whose role has 'Settings — Parts', 'See Financial Data', 'Customers — View' and 'Customers — Create & Edit'.
  • Have a new tier for this test, tier A, with a name no other tier uses.
  • Have a new customer for this test, customer A, on Default for work orders and Default for Part Sales.
  • Use a desktop browser window at least 1440 pixels wide, at 100% zoom, so every column of the page shows.
custom_steps:
1. Click the Tiers tab on Settings › Pricing.
  2. Click tier A's row on the Tiers list.
  3. Click the Customers tab.
  4. Click Manage Customers.
  5. Tick customer A.
  6. Untick Work Orders on customer A's row.
  7. Untick Part Sales on customer A's row.
custom_expected:
Expected Result

Step 1:

  • The Tiers list shows tier A.

Step 2:

  • Tier A's page opens.

Step 3:

  • The Customers tab shows Manage Customers.

Step 4:

  • The Add Customers tab shows.

Step 5:

  • Customer A is ticked with both channels.

Step 6:

  • Customer A keeps Part Sales.

Step 7:

  • Customer A's row shows "Pick Work Orders, Part Sales or both."
  • The add button is off.
